# WorldScape3DEditor

**Inherits:** [Object](Object.md)

<!-- classref-introduction-group -->

## Description

This class handles all of the sculpting and painting operations for WorldScape3D.

<a id="WorldScape3DEditor_method_stop_operation"></a>

<!-- classref-method -->

`void` **stop_operation**\ (\ ) [🔗](#WorldScape3DEditor_method_stop_operation)

End a sculpting or painting operation. Commits any regions marked with [WorldScape3DRegion.edited](WorldScape3DRegion.md#WorldScape3DRegion_property_edited) in the undo/redo system and clears that flag.
